{{Quote|Hello gruesome! Beat up any lame brush-mice on your way to tell the big boys?|Han Solo, to Warto the Boltrunian|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>}}
'''Boltrunians''' were a large and muscular [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] heads, craggy faces, wide [[Nose/Legends|noses]], and heavy brow ridges. Boltrunians could live to be over 70 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old. Well-known Boltrunians included [[Warto]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]].
